projects.name: Orbital Fabrication
projects.benefit: LOWER CORVETTE COST AND BUILD TIME
projects.description: Ceres yard crews developed jigs that let a single tug build and align a hull in free fall. Standardizing the design makes every new corvette cheaper and faster to produce.

projects.name: Fire Control
projects.description: Separate hulls can share a firing solution before their weapons open up. A synchronized track gives our escorts more time to shoot before reaching a convoy.

projects.name: Fleet Escort Systems
projects.description: The Mariner trades acceleration for armor, reactor capacity and a heavier battery. It can escort fragile expedition hulls through a contested arrival.

projects.name: Habitat Engineering
projects.benefit: BUILD O'NEILL HABITATS AND SUPPORT FUSION FLIGHTS
projects.description: Closed-loop water and air systems keep crews alive through long missions. The same design makes rotating habitats and their industrial capacity possible.

projects.name: Long Burn Drive
projects.description: A reworked heat rejection loop lets ships sustain a burn long enough to reach the outer worlds. The new drive also increases acceleration on local transfers.

projects.name: Deep Sky Astrometry
projects.benefit: CHART NEARBY STARS AND SCAN FASTER
projects.description: Combining long-baseline observations gives Sol a chart of nearby systems. It also improves the instruments on every survey scout.

projects.name: Pulsed Fusion
projects.benefit: OPEN THE EXPEDITION ROUTE TO PROXIMA
projects.description: The Sol Authority has cleared a crewed flight to the silent Proxima receiver. Fit out a scout and constructor in Earth orbit. Bring an escort if you intend to hold the receiver for Sol.
